scope.market_definition: The data center systems market encompasses the physical and logical infrastructure used to build and operate data centers, including servers, storage systems, networking equipment, power and cooling systems, and the software and services that manage them. Participants include hardware manufacturers, component suppliers, system integrators, facility designers, and service providers. The market is global, covering enterprise, cloud, colocation, and edge data centers.

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]
**CASE STUDY**

## University of Wollongong

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

### Realize LIVE 2026 | Global events

Join us to explore the future of engineering, simulation and industrial AI. Pick your location and
register now.

[Realize LIVE][9]
**Technology**

## Upgrade reality

The challenges of tomorrow demand an upgrade today. We power your ideas with artificial
intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

## About Us

You may know us as a major real estate developer, expanding our footprint across the country over
the 50+ years we’ve been doing business. What you may not know is that at Sabey, we’ve been
passionately pursuing the cutting edge of the biotech, healthcare and technology industries.

[Scientific Lab with microscopes]
[Scientific Lab with microscopes]

Sabey Data Centers

## Data centers that do more

Around the world, “Sabey” is synonymous with data centers. Operating more than 3.5 million square
feet of mission-critical data center space and nearly 400 MW of critical capacity under management,
SDC is one of the largest privately-owned multi-tenant data center operators and developers in the
world.

[Data Centers][22]

[Dark data center corridor with server racks on either side]
[Dark data center corridor with server racks on either side]

## The benefits of an integrated approach

To ensure you get exactly what you want on an agreed-upon timeline, Sabey practices a vertically
integrated approach. We provide design, development, construction and property management services
that give you the environment you need every day to drive your success.  

Design

Our team of in-house architects will help you visualize your project. Whether we’re helping you with
a build-to-suit data center or we’re retrofitting an old warehouse to become a high-tech test lab,
our team will make sure every design detail is considered before and during construction.  

[Learn More][23]

[Two people leaning over a desk with papers sprawled across it and papers pinned on the wall in the
background.]
[Two people leaning over a desk with papers sprawled across it and papers pinned on the wall in the
background.]

Construction

Sabey Construction brings over five decades of construction experience to each project. Often
building for our own tenants, Sabey Construction maintains a full complement of in-house services
that extends far beyond those normally available through general contractors.

[Learn More][24]

Property Management

Nothing is more gratifying to us than satisfied customers. That’s why, for more than 40 years, we’ve
managed our own properties with staff that is focused on building strong, long-term relationships.
The purpose of each property manager and engineer is to provide the high-quality, responsive service
that makes your workplace both pleasant and efficient.

[Learn More][25]

Our Impact

## Servers run inside, salmon run outside

As it developed abandoned farmland in Tukwila, WA into a plant for Boeing in 1986, Sabey Corporation
took note of the humble Riverton Creek that ran through the property and emptied into the Duwamish
River. Inspired by the rich ecology, native culture and Seattle history flowing between that river’s
banks, Sabey took special care to preserve the habitat by rehabilitating the creek. Community and
sustainability are values that run deep in our organization...

[Read More][26]

[blue pixel icon waterdrop] 100% Less water usage per kW of ITE power 40% Less power usage per kW of ITE power [green pixel icon] 84% Less cooling usage per kW of ITE power [pink pixel icon] 40% Lower carbon emissions per kW of ITE power [Aerial view of a coastal marshland with tidal channels and dark water surrounding grassy land.] [Silhouette of an electrical transmission tower and power lines against a sunset sky.] [Close-up of a computer motherboard circuit with various electronic components.] [Aerial view of solar panels and wind turbines on green farmland at sunset.] technology ## Iceotope precision liquid cooling technology is integrated at both the chassis and system level. [ More about technology ][32] Chassis level System level [Chassis Level Diagram] [green pixel icon] ### At the chassis level Iceotope precision liquid cooling uses a small amount of dielectric coolant inside a fully sealed server chassis. The coolant is pumped through an internal manifold that runs past the hottest components, where it absorbs heat through forced convection After targeting these hotspots, the coolant flows over the motherboard and other components, picking up remaining system heat. The total heat from each server is then transferred to a Technology Cooling System (TCS) loop via a liquid‑to‑liquid heat exchanger located at the rear of the chassis. Iceotope’s design supports inlet coolant temperatures above 55°C, enabling efficient warm‑water operation and easier heat reuse. [ Start a conversation ][33] [System Level Diagram] [purple pixel icon] ### At the system level Liquid-cooled chassis connect to Technology Cooling System (TCS) rack manifolds commonly used in liquid‑cooled data centers. A Coolant Distribution Unit (CDU) manages the TCS loop, controlling coolant flow, pressure, water chemistry, and temperature to keep the liquid cooling system operating smoothly Precision liquid cooling uses dielectric fluid which allows servers to safely operate at higher temperatures. As a result, the rejected heat is typically warmer than the outside air, enabling the use of dry coolers that require no additional water. Excess heat can be removed via ambient air or captured for reuse in applications such as space heating or other onsite processes. # Webinar

## Reducing Grid Strain and Supporting Operational Growth with Fuel Cells

Learn how hydrogen fuel cells can help facilities reduce grid strain, avoid costly upgrades, and
support growth.

[Watch On Demand][71]

# Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

[Learn More][72]
[Green hydrogen ecosystem]


## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]
[Store and Handle Hydrogen]


## Use Hydrogen

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

[Learn more][77]
[Forklift fuel cell]

## Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

[MHE forklifts]

Warehouses and distribution centers are seeking alternatives to lead-acid batteries.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[Learn More][78]
[electrolyzer decarb]

Industrial applications are working to decarbonize their operations.

**Learn how Plug makes this possible.**

[Learn More][79]
[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

**Hydrogen is making it happen.**

[Learn More][80]

## Plug is Powering the Hydrogen Revolution

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help
them solve tough productivity and operational challenges. Hydrogen can be used in many different
applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[[Capital Market Days 2026 banner]][11]
[Stay ahead - world map]
[Stay ahead - engineer]
[Stay ahead - man on vessel ramp]

## Stay ahead. Decide smarter.

Are you making the decisions that will keep your fleet competitive tomorrow?

Discover what maritime leaders are prioritising – and why early, well‑timed decisions are becoming a
real competitive advantage. Get the insights and a clear, practical playbook for navigating
regulation, reducing risk and protecting long‑term ROI.

[Start reading][12]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][13][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][14][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][15][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][16][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][17][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][18]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

[Our story][19]

leading enterprises, delivering unmatched reliability, security, and innovation to power your
transformation.

comprehensive support services to meet our customers’ evolving technology requirements.

# Speed. Scale. Certainty. Responsibility.

STACK is your trusted digital infrastructure partner, delivering powered land and scalable AI/ML and
cloud density solutions to tackle the largest challenges in an increasingly complex landscape. Our
client-first approach and heightened focus on delivery empowers the world’s most innovative
companies to scale efficiently and sustainably around the globe.

[image_136]

## Client-Driven Strategy

STACK is leading the advancement of global digital infrastructure through conscientious development
practices. Our scalable campuses and design optionality allow you to grow where and when you need
to, backed by the depth and expertise of our seasoned development team. With strategic insight and a
commitment to your long-term success, STACK delivers the infrastructure solutions you can rely on.

[image_169]

## Future-Proof by Design

Our state-of-the-art data centers are designed to meet the demands of tomorrow’s digital landscape,
offering flexible, AI/ML density solutions tailored to the needs of the world’s leading companies.
Backed by our expert engineering and design teams, we deliver scalable infrastructure that supports
the evolving demands of advanced technologies.

[image_220]

## Responsibility

Corporate responsibility is core to our business ethos to deliver benefit to clients, protect
ecosystems, and strengthen communities. We embed sustainable practices into our business operations
and development strategies, ensuring responsible growth at the speed and scale our customers
require.

# Minecraft servers.
# Free. Forever.

### Your personal Minecraft server

We give you your very own personal Minecraft server, where you can play on with your friends all day
and all night.

[ Get yours now ][62]

### For Free

We are free, and we will always be free for everyone at any time. There is no possibility to pay for
anything.

[ Pay nothing now ][63]

### Easy to use

We don't know, why it could be complicated to own a Minecraft server. At Aternos it is just as easy
as pressing a button.

[ Press a button now ][64]

### Built to be played

We offer you servers that you can actually play and have fun on. Lots of fun. No unnecessary
restrictions to steal your time and money.

## Features

### Fully Customizable

Adjust everything on your server the way you like it and make it your game.

### Mods & Plugins

Vanilla is too boring for you? Add plugins, play with your favourite mods or use one of many
preconfigured modpacks for your very own experience.

### DDOS Protected

Your Minecraft server is fully DDOS protected for free to keep you safe from attacks.

### Automatic Backups

We can keep a backup of your server in your Google Drive, just in case you need it.

### Custom Worlds

Adventure maps, parkour or the latest minigame. You can upload any world you want to play.

### Excellent Support

If you need help, we are here to help.
[Get Help][70]

Don't run your server alone. Share access with your friends and manage your server together.

Play with as many friends as you want without unnecessary slot limitations.

### Add-Ons & Datapacks

Expand your vanilla experience with our easy drag and drop upload for Bedrock add-ons and datapacks.

### Real-time console

Managing your server couldn't be easier with our real-time live console.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Fujitsu is a Japanese multinational IT equipment and services company. It produces a wide range of hardware including servers, storage systems, and networking gear used in data centers. The company also provides IT services and solutions.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Manufactures data center hardware and provides cloud services
relevant_companies.company_summary: Huawei is a leading global provider of ICT infrastructure and smart devices. It offers data center solutions including servers, storage, networking, and cloud services. The company is known for its extensive R&D and global operations.
relevant_companies.parent: Subsidiary of Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd.
relevant_companies.acquired_by_display: acquired by Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd.

relevant_companies.company: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Contract manufactures servers and networking equipment
relevant_companies.company_summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry, also known as Foxconn, is a major electronics contract manufacturer. It produces servers, networking equipment, and other components for data center OEMs. The company is a key player in the global supply chain.
relevant_companies.hq_location: Tucheng District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Builds and operates hyperscale data centers
relevant_companies.company_summary: Chindata Group is a leading provider of hyperscale data center solutions in Asia-Pacific. It focuses on building and operating data centers for large internet and cloud companies. The company emphasizes energy efficiency and sustainable operations.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Designs semiconductors for data center networking
relevant_companies.company_summary: Qualcomm is a global leader in wireless technology and semiconductor design. It provides chips for mobile devices and increasingly for data center applications, including networking and edge computing. The company's innovations support advanced data processing.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Operates data centers and provides cloud services
relevant_companies.company_summary: China Unicom is one of China's major state-owned telecommunications operators. It offers a range of services including data center hosting, cloud computing, and network services. The company operates numerous data centers across China.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Operates carrier-neutral colocation data centers
relevant_companies.company_summary: Interxion is a European provider of carrier-neutral colocation data center services. It offers secure, high-availability data centers for cloud, content, and enterprise customers. The company has a strong presence in major European cities.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Manufactures servers, storage, and data center equipment
relevant_companies.company_summary: Hitachi is a global conglomerate with a significant presence in IT and data center systems, offering a range of hardware and services. It manufactures servers, storage systems, and other data center equipment.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Produces servers, storage, and networking equipment
relevant_companies.company_summary: Quanta Computer is a major Taiwanese OEM that produces servers, storage systems, and networking equipment for data centers. It supplies to leading cloud and technology companies.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Builds supercomputers and HPC systems
relevant_companies.company_summary: Cray specializes in supercomputers and high-performance computing systems used in data centers for complex simulations and data processing. It is known for its advanced computing technology.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Supplies batteries for backup power systems
relevant_companies.company_summary: Saft is a battery manufacturer that provides energy storage solutions, including batteries for data center backup power systems. Its products ensure reliability and continuity of operations.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Provides Ethernet switching and routing solutions
relevant_companies.company_summary: Force10 Networks was a provider of high-performance Ethernet switching and routing solutions for data centers. It focused on scalable and resilient networking infrastructure.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Manufactures high-performance servers and storage
relevant_companies.company_summary: Silicon Graphics International (SGI) was a manufacturer of high-performance servers, storage, and visualization systems for data centers and HPC environments. It provided solutions for demanding workloads.

relevant_companies.market_role_detail: Offers colocation, managed hosting, and cloud services
relevant_companies.company_summary: Viawest was a provider of data center services including colocation, managed hosting, and cloud solutions. It operated multiple data centers and offered connectivity and security services.

all_classified.summary: Broadcom designs and sells semiconductor solutions for data center networking and storage, including Ethernet switches, adapters, and storage controllers, serving cloud and enterprise data centers.
all_classified.role_description: networking storage semiconductor solutions for center infrastructure
all_classified.key_products: Ethernet switches, network adapters, storage controllers, Fibre Channel HBAs

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,
scale, and flexibility.

### Future-proofed workplaces

Create agile, resilient workplaces that evolve with employee needs and deliver incredible customer

### Digital resilience

Keep your organization securely up and running in the face of any disruption—from cyberattacks to

# Minecraft servers.
# Free. Forever.

### Your personal Minecraft server

We give you your very own personal Minecraft server, where you can play on with your friends all day
and all night.

[ Get yours now ][62]

### For Free

We are free, and we will always be free for everyone at any time. There is no possibility to pay for
anything.

[ Pay nothing now ][63]

### Easy to use

We don't know, why it could be complicated to own a Minecraft server. At Aternos it is just as easy
as pressing a button.

[ Press a button now ][64]

### Built to be played

We offer you servers that you can actually play and have fun on. Lots of fun. No unnecessary
restrictions to steal your time and money.

[ Play now ][65]
139,986,757 Users
1Million Players every day
[Start][66]
[Sign up][67]
[Play][68]
219,219 GB RAM
100,213 Players online
[Enjoy][69]

## Features

### Fully Customizable

Adjust everything on your server the way you like it and make it your game.

### Mods & Plugins

Vanilla is too boring for you? Add plugins, play with your favourite mods or use one of many
preconfigured modpacks for your very own experience.

### DDOS Protected

Your Minecraft server is fully DDOS protected for free to keep you safe from attacks.

### Automatic Backups

We can keep a backup of your server in your Google Drive, just in case you need it.

### Custom Worlds

Adventure maps, parkour or the latest minigame. You can upload any world you want to play.

### Excellent Support

If you need help, we are here to help.
[Get Help][70]

## Games

### Minecraft: Java Edition

Vanilla
Snapshots

Arclight
Combine the power of mods and plugins to get the best of both worlds.

### Minecraft: Bedrock Edition

Bedrock
The official server software with full survival support for your own SMP experience.
Pocketmine
Use this server software to create your own experience using plugins.

### Hytale

Hytale
The official server software with full modding support for your own Hytale server.

### Create your free SMP

Your own survival multiplayer experience, free forever.

### Custom domains

Use your own domain to connect to your server.

### Share access

Don't run your server alone. Share access with your friends and manage your server together.

### Unlimited slots

Play with as many friends as you want without unnecessary slot limitations.

### Add-Ons & Datapacks

Expand your vanilla experience with our easy drag and drop upload for Bedrock add-ons and datapacks.

### Real-time console

Managing your server couldn't be easier with our real-time live console.

[[DCS Information Systems]][1]

#### [AmeriFind Login][2]   

DCS Information Systems is the premier provider of online investigative solutions for business and
government - from financial institutions to law enforcement and investigators.

[Learn more »][3]


## Reliable Intelligence

Our online database products help organizations prevent and detect fraud, verify application
information, and locate debtors, missing persons, heirs or assets. DCS is well known for its fast,
straightforward and user friendly system and has been providing computer related information
services since 1966. DCS provides information comprised of public records and publicly available
information.


## Web Based

With DCS' AmeriFind^{SM} online resource, obtaining the critical information you need has never been
easier. The AmeriFind system is available using your existing web browser. With its streamlined
presentation, AmeriFind is designed to provide your employees with quick access and answers. DCS
provides real-time usage monitoring through AmeriFind's system activity reporting and also offers
customizable combined reports for large accounts.


## Custom Solutions

DCS also offers customization services to meet your specific information needs. Please note, we do
not sell products to the general public. To request a contract or more detailed information about
DCS products, please contact us to provide some information about your company.

# OBS Studio

Latest Release 32.2.2 - August 14th
[WindowsSupports Windows 10 and Windows 11][8] [macOSSupports macOS 12.0 or newer][9] [Linux][10]

[‹][11] [macOS (Intel)][12] [macOS (Apple Silicon)][13]

Free and open source software for video recording and live streaming.

Download and start streaming quickly and easily on Windows, Mac or Linux.

The OBS Project is made possible thanks to generous contributions from our sponsors and backers.
Learn more about how you can [become a sponsor][14].

# Features

High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple
sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.

Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.

Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take
full control with VST plugin support.

Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust
their properties effortlessly.

Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every
aspect of your broadcast or recording.

Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each
individual Dock to its own window.

OBS supports all your favorite streaming platforms and more.

# Create Professional Productions

Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your
scenes or add your own stinger video files.

Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping
streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.

**Studio Mode** lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your
scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.

Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily
cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

# Collaborative Creativity

OBS Studio is equipped with a powerful API, enabling plugins and scripts to provide further
customization and functionality specific to your needs.

Utilize native plugins for high performance integrations or scripts written with Lua or Python that
interface with existing sources.

Work with developers in the streaming community to get the features you need with endless
possibilities.

Browse or submit your own in the [Resources section][23]

Data are for 2023 except Japan (2022); source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025). License: CC BY.] Today ### Meat preferences vary a lot across different countries Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Arriagada America’s most popular type of meat is chicken. In Argentina, it’s beef. And in Japan, it’s seafood. There are large differences in the popularity of meat types across the world. In the chart, you can see the share of supply that comes from different types of meat: poultry, beef, pork, sheep and goat, and fish and seafood. I’ve picked just a selection of countries that highlight some of the variation across the world. Of course, countries also eat very different amounts of meat; this chart focuses on the relative quantities in national diets. This data comes from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations. Explore the most popular types of meat in your country in the global dataset Continue reading ][48] * [ [Line chart of Thailand's population from 1950 to 2100 where UN estimates show a rise to a peak around 2020 to 2025 at about 70 million, followed by a projected decline through 2100. Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024). License: CC BY.] August 22 ### Thailand’s population may have already peaked Hannah Ritchie, Edouard Mathieu, and Lucas Rodés-Guirao Many countries are in a fairly unique demographic position in history: their populations are shrinking not due to a temporary shock but to sustained structural decline. If we look at the United Nations’ population estimates and medium projections, 66 countries and territories had already passed peak population this year. Almost all of them are in Europe and East Asia. But there is one country in Southeast Asia in this position: Thailand. As you can see in the chart, the UN projects that its population will continue to fall throughout this century. This is the result of a rapid drop in fertility rates. In 1970, women in Thailand had an average of 6 children; twenty years later, that had fallen to 2. This was as fast as China’s decline. Today, the rate is at most 1.2 children per woman, and some national statistics put it closer to 1. What makes Thailand unusual is that this happened while it was still a relatively poor country. In 1970, it launched its National Family Planning Program. This was voluntary and non-coercive, but effectively increased contraceptive use, family planning access, and education levels for women. Explore which other countries may have already peaked Continue reading ][49] * [ [Horizontal bar chart of official development assistance (ODA) as a share of gross national income for selected developed countries in 2025, where it shows four countries (Norway, Luxembourg, Sweden, and Denmark) meeting the UN target of 0.7 percent of national income, while most others fall below that level. Source: OECD (2026). License: CC BY.] August 20 ### Four developed countries met the UN’s target for foreign aid in 2025 Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Arriagada In the 1970s, the UN General Assembly adopted a resolution asking developed countries to contribute at least 0.7% of their national income to foreign aid. Most countries signed off on this goal, except for Switzerland and the United States. But very few countries have met this target in the fifty years since then. Even today, only a handful of countries do. In 2023, five countries met this target: Norway, Luxembourg, Sweden, Germany, and Denmark. Two years on, this has dropped to four, as Germany’s contribution shrank to 0.6%. As you can see in the chart, other developed countries give less than 0.7% of their national income. Explore more of our charts on foreign aid: who contributes, and where it goes Continue reading ][50] * [ [Line chart of GDP per capita for selected countries from 1990 to 2026 (international-$ at 2021 prices, adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs) where Guyana's line shows a sharp increase after oil production began in December 2019, indicating the fastest recent GDP per capita growth among the countries shown. Data source: Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026). License: CC BY.] August 18 ### Guyana’s oil-driven economy has seen the world’s fastest growth in GDP per capita in recent ### years Esteban Ortiz-Ospina and Pablo Arriagada Guyana, a small country in South America, has seen the fastest growth in gross domestic product (GDP) per capita in the world over the past decade. This is illustrated in the chart, which shows GDP per capita for Guyana and several other countries, based on estimates from the World Bank. The data is adjusted for inflation, so Guyana’s sharp growth is not due to price changes over time. A large and sudden expansion in oil production has driven most of this growth. Between 2020 and 2025, the country’s oil production grew 860%, making it a key contributor to global crude oil supply growth. Before oil extraction started, Guyana’s GDP per capita was well below the global average. It is now more than three times higher. It’s too early to see the full effects of this, and hard to measure how far the oil boom has translated into better living standards in the country. Official poverty estimates, for example, have not been published since production began. But there is early evidence of the government channeling oil revenue toward citizens, for instance, through cash grants for every adult, free tuition at public universities, and increasing health spending. Read more about oil production and fossil fuels Continue reading ][51] * [ [Horizontal bar chart of total public and private health expenditure per person in 2023 by country income group, adjusted for differences in living costs, where it highlights large disparities in spending between rich and poor countries. High-income: $7,300 per person; upper-middle-income: $1,400; lower-middle-income: $360; low-income: $125. Data source: Global Health Expenditure Database, WHO, via World Bank (2026). This is based on spending data from the World Health Organization’s Global Health Observatory, which you can see in the chart across levels of income. ## Save Money with Storage Seeker

Storage Seeker is the most comprehensive online database of storage units that allows you to find,
compare and reserve space in self-storage facilities. Using state-of-the-art mapping and comparison
tools, Storageseeker.com gives you the ability to search for the best prices for storage units or
space for RVs and vehicles and make reservations online. You can reserve a self-storage space online
for the move-in date that works for you for free and then visit the facility to finalize the rental.
By comparing prices for storage units online and then getting the best discount or move-in special,
you can save a lot of money over time!

## StorageSeeker.com gives you the ability to easily:
* Find self-storage units near you
* Compare storage unit prices between cities
* Reserve a mini storage space online for free

## Filter Units to Find Exactly What You Need

When someone is trying to find a self-storage unit for rent, there are a lot of options out there.
That can be really overwhelming! Luckily StorageSeeker can help you find the right storage unit in a
number of different ways including: filtering space amenities, showing available discounts, and
letting you compare storage prices for multiple properties in your neighborhood. This helps
potential storage unit renters obtain the most complete picture of the available options when they
need to store items for their home, business, or recreational vehicles.


## The Perfect Fit

Storageseeker.com provides a variety of [self-storage size options][6] available as well when
renters are looking for units in their respective cities. These range from smaller sizes such as
5’x5’ or 5’x10’ units that are closet-sized and can store a few household items or act as excess
space for small apartments - to larger sizes such as 10’x10’ and 10’x15’ units that can store entire
households that are moving or business inventory. The unit sizes also get as large as 10’x20’ to
10’x30’ and above, which can store items for a large house, major business, boat, RV or other
vehicle.

Compare by price, amenities, discounts and more. [Wallet] ### 3 Reserve Reserve with a single click. It’s 100% free, no obligations or fine print. ## Save Money with Storage Seeker Storage Seeker is the most comprehensive online database of storage units that allows you to find, compare and reserve space in self-storage facilities. Using state-of-the-art mapping and comparison tools, Storageseeker.com gives you the ability to search for the best prices for storage units or space for RVs and vehicles and make reservations online. You can reserve a self-storage space online for the move-in date that works for you for free and then visit the facility to finalize the rental. By comparing prices for storage units online and then getting the best discount or move-in special, you can save a lot of money over time! ## StorageSeeker.com gives you the ability to easily: * Find self-storage units near you * Compare storage unit prices between cities * Reserve a mini storage space online for free ## Filter Units to Find Exactly What You Need When someone is trying to find a self-storage unit for rent, there are a lot of options out there. That can be really overwhelming! Luckily StorageSeeker can help you find the right storage unit in a number of different ways including: filtering space amenities, showing available discounts, and letting you compare storage prices for multiple properties in your neighborhood. This helps potential storage unit renters obtain the most complete picture of the available options when they need to store items for their home, business, or recreational vehicles. ## The Perfect Fit Storageseeker.com provides a variety of [self-storage size options][6] available as well when renters are looking for units in their respective cities. These range from smaller sizes such as 5’x5’ or 5’x10’ units that are closet-sized and can store a few household items or act as excess space for small apartments - to larger sizes such as 10’x10’ and 10’x15’ units that can store entire households that are moving or business inventory. The unit sizes also get as large as 10’x20’ to 10’x30’ and above, which can store items for a large house, major business, boat, RV or other vehicle. ### We help customers choose better facilities with reviews like these ★★★★★ They were professional, helpful, quick and kind. ### Introduction

[「首が…ある！？
幼く…なってる！?」大国・ティアムーン帝国で“わがまま姫”と蔑まれた20歳の皇女ミーアは、民衆の革命によっ
て断頭台で処刑された。はずが、目覚めると12歳の頃にタイムリープしていた！どうやらここは、やり直しの世
界――彼女の枕元に置かれていたのは、処刑される前に自らが綴った血染めの日記。第二の人生を歩み始めたミー
アは、帝国の立て直しを決意。帝国の未来のため？民衆を飢饉から救うため？内戦により命を落とす多くの兵士
のため？じゃない！
すべてはギロチンの運命を回避するため！！「こ、これぐらいわたくしにかかれば簡単ですわ！」小心者で、保
身上等＆自己中最強のポンコツ姫が、自分のために大奮闘。わがまま姫様の行動がまさかの奇跡を巻き起こす、
歴史改変ファンタジーが始まる。]

# The future doesn't need another cloud.It needs every cloud, connected

From powering enterprise AI to protecting data sovereignty, your clouds, data and AI workloads must
work as one—privately, at scale and free from lock-in.

[Explore Connectivity Solutions][57][Talk to Equinix][58]

## Enterprise AI is distributed everywhere.That's why you need Equinix.

The global infrastructure that connects your clouds, your data and your AI. Everywhere it runs.

[Explore Distributed AI][59][Talk to an expert][60]
AI demands more than a single cloud

Enterprise AI spans clouds, platforms and data. Equinix connects them so AI can run faster, better
and smarter.

AI runs where data lives

Equinix data centers unite clouds, networks and SaaS in one global ecosystem. Putting your AI closer
to the data and the compute it needs.

Sovereignty is non-negotiable

Keep data where regulations demand while scaling across clouds, partners and markets. All from one
unified platform.

Intelligence can't wait

The unequaled proximity of Equinix data centers put AI within milliseconds of the data and compute
it needs to scale.

classify.summary: Telefonica is a global telecommunications company providing fixed and mobile connectivity, as well as cloud and IT services. It is not a manufacturer or direct supplier of data center systems hardware.
classify.role_description: Telecommunications provider offering connectivity services, center hardware
classify.key_products: Telecom services, cloud services, data connectivity

all_classified.summary: Vodafone is a global telecommunications company providing mobile and fixed-line services, IoT connectivity, and cloud solutions to enterprises and consumers. Its core business is not focused on data center systems.
all_classified.role_description: Telecommunications provider offering connectivity IoT services for enterprises
all_classified.key_products: Mobile and fixed-line connectivity, IoT connectivity, cloud and hosting services
all_classified.company_summary: Vodafone is a global telecommunications company providing mobile and fixed-line services, IoT connectivity, and cloud solutions to enterprises and consumers. Its core business is not focused on data center systems.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]
**CASE STUDY**

## University of Wollongong

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

Join us to explore the future of engineering, simulation and industrial AI. Pick your location and
register now.

[Realize LIVE][9]
**Technology**

## Upgrade reality

The challenges of tomorrow demand an upgrade today. We power your ideas with artificial
intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

[Learn more][245] # Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions ## About Toshiba AMERICA ### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions ### across the Americas. [ Learn More ][246] ## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward. Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet. [ Learn More ][247] [Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.] [Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.] [Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.] ## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the innovation and reliability that powers modern industry. Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future. [ Learn More ][248] ## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. ### This is Celestica

At Celestica, we engineer the technologies that shape what’s next. We partner with leading brands to
solve their toughest challenges – and together accelerate market advancements.

[What we do 2026]

### What we do

Celestica is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With
deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions, Celestica
enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances
technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica
helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage.

[ Learn more ][67]

### Expertise Across Industries

Technology is driving advancements that are revolutionizing the way we live and work. Our end-to-end
product lifecycle solutions support the most complex products across multiple markets, including
communications, enterprise, aerospace and defense, smart energy, healthcare technology, industrial
and capital equipment.
[ View our markets][68]

### Lifecycle Solutions

 Accelerate speed-to-market and innovation through end-to-end lifecycle solutions.

The Nokia optical network portfolio leverages highly vertically integrated coherent optical engines to build an advanced-connectivity foundation for the AI supercycle. This portfolio includes open modular transport platforms, intelligent pluggables, the latest generation of open and flexible optical line systems, ultra power-efficient intra-data center optics, AI-powered network automation and control, and quantum-safe assurance. Our optical network innovations and technologies deliver greater scale, simplify networks and provide robust security. These solutions will help telecommunication providers and enterprises scale faster, compete in the AI era and unlock new growth opportunities. ### Scale efficiently Leverage our suite of carrier-grade modular platforms to support a wide range of services and traffic management features, coupled with the latest generation of efficient, high-capacity coherent optical engines. ### Simplify operations Reduce operational complexity and accelerate service activation and troubleshooting with full-featured, standards-based, multi-domain, AI-powered network automation. ### Secure your network Achieve the highest level of network security by taking advantage of the latest technologies, including data-path encryption and quantum key distribution. [AI] ## Scalable, agile data center connectivity built for AI A highly compact, optical networking solution for data center interconnect (DCI) to enable power-efficient, high-bandwidth, low-latency and secure data transmission. [Explore DCI][200] ## Introducing the thin transponder layer Get the best of both worlds with compact, power-efficient sleds integrating coherent pluggable optics with cost-effective transponder functionality. [Discover the benefits][201] [optical thin transponder] [Image] ## Lighting the path to intra-data center connectivity Nokia ICE-D intra-data center optical connectivity technology provides a power-efficient (up to a 75% reduction), highly integrated solution that combines multiple optical functions onto a single monolithic semiconductor chip. [Learn more ][202] ## Why Nokia as my networking partner? At Nokia, we combine deep innovation with global scale to help you build and operate optical networks with confidence. Our vertically integrated Indium phosphide fab, together with advanced in-house testing and packaging, gives you greater assurance of performance, quality and supply continuity. With our material science expertise, we continuously push innovation forward while strengthening the resilience of our products, so you can deploy faster and scale reliably. The result is greater control over innovation and supply, reducing risk in a rapidly evolving market. Backed by our global presence and local support wherever you operate, and supported by a distributed delivery infrastructure, Nokia enables you to deploy and scale optical solutions globally with confidence. ## Customer success stories [skyline] ### [ SkyFiber builds future-proof fiber network for underserved Northern Nevada ][203] [greenfield] ### [ altafiber expands its multi-gig fiber network across Ohio and Hawaii with Nokia ][204] [Fiber lights] ### [ Bridged Broadband bridges digital divide with Nokia's IP and optical solutions ][205] [City] ### [ Nokia and Nscale partner to accelerate AI infrastructure build-out ][206] [light patterns] ### [ Windstream Wholesale and Colt Technology Services achieve transatlantic 800GbE breakthrough ### with Nokia ][207] [map] ### [ Nokia selected for Medusa Submarine Cable System to bring new connectivity ac

[ Discover AgentExchange ][54] ## Get started today ## There's nothing to install. No credit card required. Free for 30 days [ Try for free ][55] ## Salesforce CRM FAQs ### What is Salesforce? Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][56] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic AI][57] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][58] and [what Salesforce does][59] by visiting [our official resources][60]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads, close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic platform. ### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it? [**CRM**][61] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system helps you: **• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data **• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails** • Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][62], allowing you to build stronger, more profitable relationships at scale. ### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce? [**Agentic AI**][63] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act [**autonomously**][64] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike traditional [AI][65] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan multistep actions, and execute tasks. In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][66] technology — is used to: **• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution **• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close **• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels ### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India? Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and small businesses][67] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][68] platform that can grow with your business. [Salesforce Starter][69] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are. CyrusOne designs, builds, and operates industry-leading data centers globally for the world's
leading enterprises, delivering unmatched reliability, security, and innovation to power your
transformation.

**Ready to explore what we can achieve together?**

### Build-to-Suit

We partner with organizations to create purpose-built data center solutions that align precisely
with business objectives. Our collaborative approach combines innovative design with proven
development practices to ensure rapid, reliable deployment across global markets.

CyrusOne leads in hyperscale data center solutions, delivering the performance, availability, and
scalability required by the world's largest companies. Our facilities support massive computational
demands while enabling rapid deployment and expansion.

[ Learn More ][76]

### AI Data Centers

Intelliscale™, our purpose-built AI infrastructure solution, addresses the intense computational
demands of artificial intelligence applications. This advanced platform delivers the power density,
cooling efficiency, and scalability required for next-generation AI workloads.

[ Learn More ][77]
[Internet]

### Colocation

Our enterprise colocation solutions provide secure, connected environments for business-critical
infrastructure. CyrusOne's facilities offer flexible scaling options, robust connectivity, and
comprehensive support services to meet our customers’ evolving technology requirements.

## A Place where data buildstomorrow

The world of tomorrow will be driven by how we use one resource in smarter ways: DATA

Companies that harness the power of data, will transform the world. They’ll change the way that
people interact, transact and learn. They’ll shape the way we live from the cloud.

To scale and sustain our digital future, these companies need data centres like them – responsive,
dynamic and efficient.

AirTrunk combines regional insight, innovative design and a ground-breaking team to create the
hyperscale data centre platform needed to power the cloud in Asia-Pacific & Middle East.

If the future is in the cloud…

AirTrunk is where the cloud meets the ground.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# Data Centers
# Done Differently

We deliver hyperscale campuses built to last. Our industrialized model brings predictability,
consistency and reliable performance to every market – supported by long-standing partners and a
commitment to the communities we’re part of.

[Exterior view of the Compass Datacenters Leesburg, Virginia campus with a team member onsite.]
[Aerial view of the Compass Datacenters campus in Red Oak, Texas.]
[Workers guiding a precast concrete section into place during data center construction.]

## A Manufacturing Mindset For Hyperscale Growth

Standardized, efficient construction that scales with demand.

A consistent, scalable design.
[Interior view of a Compass Datacenters data hall under construction.]

Rather than treating each build as a one-off project, Compass uses a consistent design across all
campuses. This standardization ensures control over the variables that matter most: cost, quality,
schedule and long-term operability – while enabling fungibility across regions. Components, crews
and capacity can be shifted as needed to keep hyperscaler roadmaps on track.

Off-site prefabrication for faster, more predictable delivery
[Workers installing a precast concrete panel during data center construction.]

With ˜85% of each data center manufactured off-site using a standard kit-of-parts, Compass removes
the risks of stick-built construction. The result: faster, more predictable delivery with fewer
surprises and the ability to redirect resources between markets when demand spikes.

Quality and efficiency built-in
[Team member reviewing predictive analytics data inside a Compass Datacenters data hall.]

Factory environments mean fewer errors, less rework and delays on-site.  Every component arrives
tested, refined and ready – driving consistent quality and more cost-efficient outcomes at scale.

Safety-first construction
[Construction worker wearing safety gear conducting an inspection inside a facility.]

By shifting complex, high-risk tasks into controlled factory settings, Compass minimizes heavy
lifting and elevated work on-site – making our campuses safer from day one. This approach also
creates predictable schedules and steady work for local crews, contributing to a more stable and
inclusive workforce.

# Speed. Scale. Certainty. Responsibility.

STACK is your trusted digital infrastructure partner, delivering powered land and scalable AI/ML and
cloud density solutions to tackle the largest challenges in an increasingly complex landscape. Our
client-first approach and heightened focus on delivery empowers the world’s most innovative
companies to scale efficiently and sustainably around the globe.

[image_136]

## Client-Driven Strategy

STACK is leading the advancement of global digital infrastructure through conscientious development
practices. Our scalable campuses and design optionality allow you to grow where and when you need
to, backed by the depth and expertise of our seasoned development team. With strategic insight and a
commitment to your long-term success, STACK delivers the infrastructure solutions you can rely on.

[image_169]

## Future-Proof by Design

Our state-of-the-art data centers are designed to meet the demands of tomorrow’s digital landscape,
offering flexible, AI/ML density solutions tailored to the needs of the world’s leading companies.
Backed by our expert engineering and design teams, we deliver scalable infrastructure that supports
the evolving demands of advanced technologies.

[image_220]

## Responsibility

Corporate responsibility is core to our business ethos to deliver benefit to clients, protect
ecosystems, and strengthen communities. We embed sustainable practices into our business operations
and development strategies, ensuring responsible growth at the speed and scale our customers
require.

## About Us

You may know us as a major real estate developer, expanding our footprint across the country over
the 50+ years we’ve been doing business. What you may not know is that at Sabey, we’ve been
passionately pursuing the cutting edge of the biotech, healthcare and technology industries.

Sabey Data Centers

## Data centers that do more

Around the world, “Sabey” is synonymous with data centers. Operating more than 3.5 million square
feet of mission-critical data center space and nearly 400 MW of critical capacity under management,
SDC is one of the largest privately-owned multi-tenant data center operators and developers in the
world.

[Data Centers][22]

[Dark data center corridor with server racks on either side]
[Dark data center corridor with server racks on either side]

## The benefits of an integrated approach

To ensure you get exactly what you want on an agreed-upon timeline, Sabey practices a vertically
integrated approach. We provide design, development, construction and property management services
that give you the environment you need every day to drive your success.  

Design

Our team of in-house architects will help you visualize your project. Whether we’re helping you with
a build-to-suit data center or we’re retrofitting an old warehouse to become a high-tech test lab,
our team will make sure every design detail is considered before and during construction.  

[Learn More][23]

[Two people leaning over a desk with papers sprawled across it and papers pinned on the wall in the
background.]
[Two people leaning over a desk with papers sprawled across it and papers pinned on the wall in the
background.]

Construction

Sabey Construction brings over five decades of construction experience to each project. Often
building for our own tenants, Sabey Construction maintains a full complement of in-house services
that extends far beyond those normally available through general contractors.

[Learn More][24]

Property Management

Nothing is more gratifying to us than satisfied customers. That’s why, for more than 40 years, we’ve
managed our own properties with staff that is focused on building strong, long-term relationships.
The purpose of each property manager and engineer is to provide the high-quality, responsive service
that makes your workplace both pleasant and efficient.

[Learn More][25]

Our Impact

## Servers run inside, salmon run outside

As it developed abandoned farmland in Tukwila, WA into a plant for Boeing in 1986, Sabey Corporation
took note of the humble Riverton Creek that ran through the property and emptied into the Duwamish
River. Inspired by the rich ecology, native culture and Seattle history flowing between that river’s
banks, Sabey took special care to preserve the habitat by rehabilitating the creek. Community and
sustainability are values that run deep in our organization...

What you may not know is that at Sabey, we’ve been passionately pursuing the cutting edge of the biotech, healthcare and technology industries. [Scientific Lab with microscopes] [Scientific Lab with microscopes] [Medical research facility, beds in an open room with large medical equipment] [Medical research facility, beds in an open room with large medical equipment] [Office worker sitting in front of two computer monitors] [Office worker sitting in front of two computer monitors] [Worker with laptop doing maintenance on a data center] [Worker with laptop doing maintenance on a data center] Sabey Data Centers ## Data centers that do more Around the world, “Sabey” is synonymous with data centers. Operating more than 3.5 million square feet of mission-critical data center space and nearly 400 MW of critical capacity under management, SDC is one of the largest privately-owned multi-tenant data center operators and developers in the world. [Data Centers][22] [Dark data center corridor with server racks on either side] [Dark data center corridor with server racks on either side] ## The benefits of an integrated approach To ensure you get exactly what you want on an agreed-upon timeline, Sabey practices a vertically integrated approach. We provide design, development, construction and property management services that give you the environment you need every day to drive your success. Design Our team of in-house architects will help you visualize your project. Whether we’re helping you with a build-to-suit data center or we’re retrofitting an old warehouse to become a high-tech test lab, our team will make sure every design detail is considered before and during construction. [Learn More][23] [Two people leaning over a desk with papers sprawled across it and papers pinned on the wall in the background.] [Two people leaning over a desk with papers sprawled across it and papers pinned on the wall in the background.] Construction Sabey Construction brings over five decades of construction experience to each project. [Learn More][24] Property Management Nothing is more gratifying to us than satisfied customers. That’s why, for more than 40 years, we’ve managed our own properties with staff that is focused on building strong, long-term relationships. The purpose of each property manager and engineer is to provide the high-quality, responsive service that makes your workplace both pleasant and efficient. [Learn More][25] Our Impact ## Servers run inside, salmon run outside As it developed abandoned farmland in Tukwila, WA into a plant for Boeing in 1986, Sabey Corporation took note of the humble Riverton Creek that ran through the property and emptied into the Duwamish River. Inspired by the rich ecology, native culture and Seattle history flowing between that river’s banks, Sabey took special care to preserve the habitat by rehabilitating the creek. Community and sustainability are values that run deep in our organization... We value the way our teams work together, > the leadership collaboration and the innovative thinking DXC brings to our organization. Together, > we are accelerating our digital transformation across our UK business and bringing products and > services to customers faster. > > **Sallyann Fowles** Deputy UK CIO, Leonardo [@Leonardo UK Ltd.] Consumer & Retail ## From brick-and-mortar to digital-first, at McDonald’s scale As digital competition intensified across Latin America, Arcos Dorados needed a scalable, data-driven ecosystem. DXC delivered: 40% of total sales now come through digital channels, backed by a 60–70% increase in transactional data. [ Read the story ][138] > With DXC, we’ve built a digital ecosystem that gives us near real-time sales visibility and > significantly richer data. This foundation is critical as we move toward advanced analytics and > AI. > > **Diego Marin** Head of the Technology Division, Arcos Dorados Travel & Transportation ## Reliability below the wing, delight above it — United Airlines reimagined Determined to modernize legacy systems and elevate the passenger experience, United Airlines transformed its mission-critical mainframe infrastructure and launched passenger-first mobile apps — keeping 500,000 daily travelers connected, informed, and on time. [ Read the story ][139] > Modernizing the mainframe is key for us., It’s not easy or glamorous work but it’s a big part of > unlocking the value we want to create going forward, to continue to scale and grow. > > **Grant Milstead** VP of Digital, at United Airlines Financial Services ## Banking made accessible for 12 million customers, always on with zero barriers Faced with the imperative to serve all customers equitably in an increasingly digital world, Banco Sabadell partnered with DXC to deploy AI-driven accessibility testing at scale. With 350,000 hours of advanced testing conducted annually, Banco Sabadell has produced results that include decreasing customer drop-off , and achieving full compliance with Spanish and EU accessibility regulations. [ Read the story ][140] > DXC's expertise in managing complex IT environments and its commitment to understand our specific > banking needs have been instrumental in helping us adapt to market changes and enhance our service > delivery. > > **Susana Soler** Director of the Alicante Technology Competence Center, Banco Sabadell Public Sector ## 20 years, one gold standard: The UK Passport Service reimagined Efficiency, scalability and security define travel operations for people going to the UK, as the Home Office works with DXC to build, sustain and optimize new applications that provide users with improved experiences. [ Read the story ][141] > Working with DXC over the last two decades has helped us to transform the passport service into > the gold standard that you see today. I would recommend and endorse DXC across the industry — > partners with the scale, experience, and long-term commitment are fundamental to how we move > forward. > > **Philippa Manley** Digital Services Director, UK Home Office Manufacturing ## From days to minutes: How Ventia uses AI to win more bids, faster Ventia partnered with DXC to build Tendia, a generative AI solution that slashes bid development from days to minutes — delivering accurate and, tailored first drafts instantly, so teams spend less time searching and more time winning high-value infrastructure contracts across Australia and New Zealand. [ Read the story ][142] > We partnered with DXC to accelerate our time to market. Working with expert teams from DXC and AWS > allowed us to foster a culture of innovation within our team. * Animal bites

24-hour care for serious medical issues.

Walk in
On my way

* Chest pain or pressure

* Sudden dizziness or change in vision
* Uncontrolled bleeding
